shortDescription: Spain's Caixabank BME:CABK said on Friday that its net profit rose 21.7% in the third quarter from the same period in 2025 thanks to higher revenues and a solid performance from its insurance business.($1 = 0.8957 euros)

children: said on Friday that its net profit rose 21.7% in the third quarter from the same period in 2025 thanks to higher revenues and a solid performance from its insurance business.
The country's biggest lender by domestic assets reported a net profit of €1.76 billion ($1.97 billion) in the July to September period compared with €1.45 billion in the same period of 2025.
Analysts polled by Reuters expected a net profit of €1.63 billion.
